title: Polynomial-Time Computability of the Step Test
statement: For every finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the binary alphabet, natural numbers $c$, $B$, and $e$, and bit $b$, the function that maps a bit string $z$ to the one-bit string containing the step test for $N$, coin choice $b$, and input $z$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the binary alphabet
